decisionsTitle: The person whose held place lapses is told by email
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-02:** «Da, fă emailul pentru cel care pierde locul» — his answer to the dispatcher's proposal, after §635 found the gap. His words of the day before, of cancellations: «dacă îi anulez, primesc mail? … atunci trebuie să îi înștiințez cumva».

**The gap.** Building §635 (the backoffice's place deadlines) showed that a declaration hold released past its deadline is written `EXPIRED` / `DECLARATION_HOLD_LAPSED` in bulk by `expireStaleHolds` and **nobody is emailed**: the person who loses the place learns it only by opening their own page. At the 21 November race, 16 people hold a place unsigned; on 19 November at 10:00 the window's deadline passes, and with 10 waiting, 10 of them lose the place silently.

**Decision.** A new message type, `DECLARATION_HOLD_EXPIRED` (migration `0121`, one `ALTER TYPE … ADD VALUE`, expand only), queued for the person whose hold was released to somebody who wanted the place.

- **Where.** In `expireStaleHolds` itself, right after the bulk `update … where id in (releasing)` — whose `returning` now gives each released row's participant, locale and deadline — through `registrations/hold-lapsed-email.ts#queueHoldLapsedEmails`: one read of the released people's delivery addresses, one `enqueueEmail` per registration, in the caller's transaction and under its event lock. The release stays a bulk update; the allocator, the deadlines and `lapsedDeclarationHoldsToRelease` are untouched, and `kind` is in no condition. `expireStaleHolds` now takes a `Transaction` (every caller already passed one), because `enqueueEmail` must.
- **Every path.** `expireStaleHolds` is the only place a declaration hold is released, so every path that releases one now emails: a newcomer's confirmation (`placeForNewcomer`; the second pass when the line grows; `allocateOrWaitlist`'s `wanting`, §348), a cancellation's refill, a late signature's sweep, «Trimite-i oferta», the desk's «Dă-i un loc», the editor's capacity raise, and the maintenance job (`fillAvailableSpots`).
- **Once.** `idempotencyKey: registration:<id>:hold-lapsed` names the registration and nothing else: one email per registration ever, whatever path released it and however many times a sweep runs (a restarted registration that lapses a second time is not told twice).
- **Never when the race is over.** Not when the sweep's `over` holds — the event has started or is no longer `SCHEDULED`: every hold goes then, nobody wanted the place, and there is nothing to do about it. A cancelled event is quiet as §331 says; its holds are not released anyway. At the send, a row whose event has since been cancelled or has started, or whose registration is no longer the expired one (restarted in between), is withdrawn (`OutboxMessageWithdrawn`), §331's rule at the moment of sending.
- **TEST rows** are released and told like real ones (`AGENTS.md` §12.6), as `REGISTRATION_CANCELLED` is: the `@test.invalid` address goes nowhere and `enqueueEmail` queues no club copy for a test registration (§320). A real one's message is copied to the club's per-message list like any participant message.
- **Never inline.** The outbox row commits with the release; the drain after the response sends it (§513), and a failed send never takes the release back (`AGENTS.md` §10.5 rule 10).

**Why a new type, not `REGISTRATION_STATE_NOTICE`.** The state notice is the staff's resend for a cancelled or expired registration, and says only «Înscrierea ta … are starea: Expirată»: it cannot say the deadline that passed, where the place went or what is left to do, and its catalogue line on `/admin/emails` says an organizer resends it. A type of its own gets its own words the club may rewrite (§247), its own road (group `confirmations`, §443, as the cancellation), its own card and line on `/admin/emails`, and its own row in the forecast.

**The words** (`templates.ts`, both languages, second person). Subject «Locul tău la {event} a expirat» / "Your place at {event} has expired". The body (editable): «Locul tău la {eventTitle}, {eventStartsAtFormatted}, **a expirat**: declarația nu a fost semnată la timp.» Then the platform's lines, after the words whoever wrote them, on the same band: «Termenul pentru semnare a fost {the deadline, in the event's zone, the month spelled out, `formatDeadlineInSentence`}.» (§377: a stated deadline carries its date; from the payload's `deadline`, the row's own column otherwise) and «Altcineva aștepta un loc, așa că locul tău a trecut la lista de așteptare.» when somebody was `WAITLISTED` at the release, or «Altcineva a cerut un loc, așa că locul tău a devenit liber.» when it was a newcomer the line had no room for (§348) — a fact of the release, written in the payload (`toWaitlist`). Then one sentence of what the person can do, one of three (`notifications/domain/hold-lapsed.ts#holdLapsedNext`, over the allocator's own rules `hasDirectAvailability`, `newcomerJoinsLine`, `waitlistHasRoom`, and `registrationState`): registration open and the line takes a newcomer — «Dacă mai vrei să vii, poți intra pe lista de așteptare.», with the button «Intră pe lista de așteptare»; registration open, a free place and nobody waiting — «Dacă mai vrei să vii, te poți înscrie din nou: mai sunt locuri libere.», with «Înscrie-te din nou»; closed, or full with no room in the line — «Online nu se mai poate face nimic. Dacă în ziua evenimentului rămân locuri libere, le dă masa de înscriere.», and no button. The button is the event's ordinary registration page, a plain URL from `APP_BASE_URL` (`AGENTS.md` §8) — no token (§12.8), no manage link and no «Nu mai pot ajunge» (§558): the registration is over. A club copy carries no button (§320).

**Read at the send, not at the queueing** — the one place this departs from the brief. Inside the transaction that releases the hold the place is free for an instant before the same transaction offers it to the line (`fillAvailableSpots`), so a reading taken there would say «te poți înscrie din nou» of a place that is already somebody else's. The drain sends seconds after the commit (§513) and reads the event as it then stands, like every other fact of a message (§331, §629's place in the line).

**A lapsed offer stays silent** (§331, not reopened): `WAITLIST_OFFER_EXPIRED` stays in `never-queued.ts`. An offer was never the person's place — they were on the waiting list, were offered a place and did not take it in its hours, and the offer email itself said until when. A declaration hold is a place the person had, kept past its deadline for as long as nobody wanted it (§160), so losing it is news.

**The forecast.** «Următoarele emailuri automate» gains its own row, «expiră un loc ținut; celui care nu a semnat, că locul a trecut la altcineva» (`holdLapsed`), for each declaration hold a lapse will release before the start, at the same instant and ahead of the «expiră un loc ținut; locul trece la următorul de pe lista de așteptare» offer row, which is unchanged — the job queues the first before it makes the second. Never for a lapsing offer.

**The privacy notice** (`legal-documents/templates/privacy-notice.ts`) is not changed: its emails clause is general — «Trimitem doar mesaje despre înscrierea ta: confirmări, linkuri, lista de așteptare…» / "We send only messages about your registration: confirmations, links, the waiting list…" — and this is a message about the person's own registration and its place, as the cancellation email (§547) is, which did not change it either. No new data is processed: the address and the deadline the platform already holds.

**Documents.** `AGENTS.md` §10.5 (the `PENDING_DECLARATION -> EXPIRED` paragraph says the person is emailed, and that a hold the start releases is not) and §16.3 (the type in the list, with its paragraph); `BUSINESS.md` BR-BUS-080 (the message in the list); «Ghid» → «Retrimite declarația celor care nu au semnat», the §635 step about who loses a place, gains one sentence; `/admin/emails`' catalogue (`Admin.emails.types`, `when`, `whenShort`, `forecast.sends.holdLapsed`).

**Refused.** An email *before* the deadline: the reminder of §104's window and the last call (§160) already exist. A manage link or «Nu mai pot ajunge» on an ended registration. Sending inline, in the transaction: the outbox's whole point (BR-REQ-080-02). An email for a hold the start releases: there is nobody who took the place, and the desk confirms a paper declaration into a place still free (§160). Reopening §331 for lapsed offers.
changelogLine: - **The person who loses a held place is told by email** — when a declaration left unsigned past its deadline loses its place to somebody who wanted it, by any path, «Locul tău la … a expirat» says the deadline that passed, where the place went, and whether they can join the waiting list, register again, or only try the desk on the day; once per registration, never after the start or for a cancelled event, never for a lapsed offer; `/admin/emails` lists it and forecasts it. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given a declaration hold that `expireStaleHolds` releases to somebody who wanted the place, by any path — the maintenance job, a newcomer's confirmation, a cancellation's refill, an offer or a place given by staff, a capacity raise — when the transaction commits, then exactly one `DECLARATION_HOLD_EXPIRED` is queued for that registration (key `registration:<id>:hold-lapsed`), in its own language, to its delivery address, with the deadline that passed in the payload; a later sweep queues nothing more; a TEST registration's is queued with no club copy; it renders «Locul tău la <eveniment> a expirat», the deadline in the event's zone, whether the place went to the waiting list, and one of three next steps read at the send — join the waiting list, register again, or the desk on the day — with the registration page as its only button and no token; a hold released at or after the start, a cancelled event's, or a lapsed waiting-list offer queues none, and a row whose event was cancelled or started before the send is withdrawn (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a lapsed declaration hold released under criterion 3 while the event is scheduled and ahead, when it is released, then the person who held it is emailed once (`DECLARATION_HOLD_EXPIRED`) in the same transaction; a hold the start or a `COMPLETED` event releases is not (2026-10-02, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
